page.title: Circulars
page.description: School-wide notices, newest first. Every circular is final once issued.
page.emptyStaff: Nothing has been issued yet. A circular goes out to every parent and staff member the moment you publish it.
page.emptyReader: Nothing has been issued yet. Notices from the school office will appear here.

all.label: Everyone
all.who: Every parent and every member of staff is notified.

parent.label: Parents
parent.who: Only parents are notified, and only they can see it.

staff.label: Staff
staff.who: Only staff are notified. Parents never see this circular.

feed.loadFailed: The circulars could not be loaded.
feed.noMatchBody: No circular has “{search}” in its title or description.
feed.noAudienceParents: No circular has been issued to parents yet.
feed.noAudienceStaff: No circular has been issued to staff yet.

reader.archived: Circular archived — hidden from the school and its notification withdrawn.
reader.restored: Circular restored — the school can see it and has been notified again.
reader.archivedNoteTitle: Archived — the school cannot see this
reader.attachmentFailed: The attachment could not be loaded. Try downloading it instead.
reader.archiveWarning: This withdraws the circular from every parent and staff member, and takes the notification announcing it back out of their feeds. The text is not changed and nothing is deleted — though a push already shown on someone’s phone cannot be pulled back.
reader.reasonPlaceholder: Reason (optional, kept for the audit trail)
reader.restoreWarning: This puts the circular back in front of the school and announces it again — everyone is notified a second time, because archiving withdrew the first notification.

issue.title: Issue a circular
issue.onlyPdf: Only a PDF can be attached.
issue.tooLarge: That file is {size} — the limit is {limit} MB.

toast.all: Circular issued — every parent and staff member has been notified.
toast.parent: Circular issued — every parent has been notified.
toast.staff: Circular issued — every member of staff has been notified.

issue.failed: The circular could not be issued.
issue.finalBody: A circular cannot be edited after it is issued, and the audience you choose is notified immediately. To correct one, issue a new circular — only the school’s owner can withdraw one.
issue.audienceHint: Only this group is notified, and a staff circular never reaches the parent portal.
issue.descriptionHint: Attach the full notice as a PDF if it runs longer.

confirm.all: Every parent and staff member will be notified straight away, and this circular can never be edited. Issue it?
confirm.parent: Every parent will be notified straight away, and this circular can never be edited. Staff can still find it in the circulars list, but will not be notified. Issue it?
confirm.staff: Every member of staff will be notified straight away, and this circular can never be edited. Parents will not see it at all. Issue it?
